newsitem.title: FINLAND: Clinton-Yeltsin to meet March 19-20 - Finnish radio. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Clinton-Yeltsin to meet March 19-20 - Finnish radio. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: The proposed summit between President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin will be held on March 19 to 20, possibly continuing to March 21, Finnish radio said on Friday.
A Finnish foreign ministry official could not confirm any details about the meeting planned for the Finnish capital, saying the decision was being taken in Washington.
But he said confirmation was expected soon.

Diplomats have in recent weeks speculated that Helsinki -- which hosted a meeting between former U.S. President George Bush (corrects from Ronald Reagan) and the now-defunct Soviet Union's Mikhail Gorbachev in 1990 -- might be a good venue.
